messages:
laura: quick UX q — the notify attenuation editor in the console: do we let teams create per-tenant attenuation curves (fully custom) or only let them pick/edit from a set of shared templates? cc @matt @priya

matt: +1 to templates + per-tenant overrides. fully custom per-tenant will explode fanout logic and make notify-cost forecasting hard. templates = safer defaults.

priya: telemetry concern: whatever we pick, we should surface the *effective* attenuation that ran for each notification in logs/metrics. e.g. notify.attenuation_applied = template:slow-decay, override: none, factor:0.6

kevin: agree on templates. API-wise we can keep the policy shape backward compatible by adding an optional "attenuation_ref" and an "overrides" map. example: `POST /v1/notify/policies` body snippet:
```
{
  "name": "latency-spike",
  "threshold": {"p95": 0.99},
  "attenuation_ref": "templates/slow-decay:v2",
  "overrides": {"initial_factor": 0.8}
}
```

kevin: that keeps runtime simple: routing picks template by id, then applies small override patch.

laura: good — UX idea: when selecting a template show a small preview curve and an estimated reduction in fanout & tokens (ballpark). helps PMs choose.

matt: +preview is key. also add a toggle "enforce global cap" so tenant overrides cannot exceed a company-wide max. prevents accidental mass fanout.

priya: on telemetry tags: let's add `notify.attenuation.template_id`, `notify.attenuation.override_hash`, and `notify.attenuation.estimated_fanout_reduction` to event payloads. That will let us run regressions after rollout.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: attenuation-templates-service v1.3 -> staging at 2026-03-24T04:00Z (will post results). :rocket:

laura: rollout plan proposal: start with templates-only in console (read: no per-tenant custom curve editor), enable preview + enforcement cap, collect telemetry for 2 weeks, then evaluate enabling small numeric overrides (initial_factor etc) behind a feature flag.

kevin: implementation note: make template metadata immutable after deployment (versioned ids) to avoid history skews in telemetry. allow creating new version if you want to tweak curve.

matt: quick nit — UI should show the active version in each policy card, and a hover tooltip "uses templates/slow-decay:v2" so users know exactly which code runs.

laura: action items:
- kevin: draft API ext (attenuation_ref + overrides) + compatibility notes
- priya: telemetry tag list + example queries for expected dashboards
- matt: small mock of preview UI + cap toggle (Figma link pls)
- ops-bot: schedule staging run and post results

laura: if nobody objects i'll start the RFC tomorrow. :thumbsup:

matt: ok from me.

priya: +1.

kevin: looks good.

ops-bot: reaction recorded: :thumbsup:
